title: feat(ts): update to typescript 4
body:
* replace all ts-ignore by ts-expect-error
* remove ignores that were no longer needed
* make ignored imports work more efficiently
* update typescript-eslint (because it was needed)
* fix all errors marked by typescript-eslint
* algoliasearch v3 interop without eslint disables

this isn't a breaking change, since it only changes typescript, but worth considering
